_comment: A cooldown that calms every wildlife mob, prey or predator, in a 4-unit radius for 300 ticks plus 30 per level: they drop their current target and stop acting, though they remain the same faction and can still be damaged. Any damage, including the caster's own aura, ends the calm early. All values placeholder.
name: Calm
description: Any damage breaks it, including your own aura.
